Which fields suit you?

Ten quick questions about what you enjoy. There are no right answers, and the result is a starting point for talking with your teachers and family.

Entrance routes and scholarships

Rules, dates and eligibility change every year. Always confirm on the official website or notification before you apply.

Intermediate admission

For MPC, BiPC, MEC, CEC and HEC. Admission is through junior colleges after the SSC result. Choose your group using your interests and strengths.

AP POLYCET

The entrance test for polytechnic diploma courses after SSC. Seats are allotted by rank and branch preference.

ITI admission

Trade training such as Electrician, Fitter and COPA. Eligibility depends on the trade, so check the notification.

IIITs (RGUKT)

A merit-based integrated programme that starts after SSC. Watch for the admission notification in the summer.

Scholarships

Central and state scholarships help with fees and living costs. The National Scholarship Portal is at scholarships.gov.in.

Documents to keep ready

    Study tips

    Make a timetable you can follow

    Give each subject a fixed slot and keep one slot a week for revision. A plan you follow beats a perfect plan you skip.

    Revise in short rounds

    Study for 40 minutes, rest for 10. Revise new topics the same day, after three days and after a week.

    Practise old question papers

    Solve them against the clock. Mark the mistakes and write the correct method next to each one.

    Look after sleep and food

    Sleep 7 to 8 hours and eat regular meals. Tired minds forget faster.

    Talk when you feel stressed

    Share worries with a teacher, parent or friend early. Asking for help is part of preparing well.

    Student survey dashboard

    Enter answers from the Class X survey and the charts update at once. Responses are saved on this device only, so enter them on one device and copy the CSV to share the data.

    About this project

    Why we made it

    Many Class X students choose their stream with incomplete information. Pathfinder puts the options, the entrance routes and a short interest quiz in one place that works on a phone.

    Where we worked

    K.N.R Municipal High School, B.V Nagar, Nellore, with Class X students.

    1 June to 26 July 2026. Main project 1 June to 12 July, mini project 13 to 26 July.
